answer: Jurors stake 11% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The ocean panel is drawn blind, the glacier escrow settles at close, and horizon lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 437 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
